# Determine if Detroit had one of the lowest visitor scores this season
# First, extract the visitor scores for games where Detroit was the visitor
visitor_scores = df[df['visitor'] == 'detroit']['score'].str.split(' - ', expand=True).astype(int)
# The visitor score is the first part of the split
detroit_visitor_scores = visitor_scores[0]
# Get the minimum visitor score among all Detroit visitor games
min_detroit_visitor_score = detroit_visitor_scores.min()
# Now, get all visitor scores across the entire dataset (for all teams)
all_visitor_scores = df['score'].str.split(' - ', expand=True).astype(int)[0]
# Find the overall minimum visitor score in the season
overall_min_visitor_score = all_visitor_scores.min()
# Check if Detroit's minimum visitor score equals the overall minimum visitor score
answer = (min_detroit_visitor_score == overall_min_visitor_score)
